phrase: A country's top education official resigned after an AI exam-cheating scandal. Meanwhile, banks are banning AI agents from accounts, blaming customers for any mistakes.
phraseAlternatives: An education minister lost their job over an AI cheating scandal. Banks, meanwhile, are making sure nobody at their end pays for an AI agent's mistakes.
AI cheating cost an education minister their job. Banks are making sure an AI agent's mistakes cost only the customer.
One official resigned over AI cheating in exams. Banks just made sure AI mistakes never cost them a thing.
alt: Split paper-cutout scene divided by a thin vertical line. Left: a sad official carries a box out of a government building tagged RESIGNED. Right: a small worried robot, facing away, steps back from a bank building while a human customer stands nearby under a receipt-shaped bill tagged YOUR PROBLEM.

brief.concept: An education official walks out of a government building carrying a box after an AI cheating scandal, while across town a bank's door turns away a small AI robot and hands the bill to a human customer instead.
brief.metaphor: Accountability flows downhill: a human official pays for the AI's trick, and a human customer pays for the AI's mistake, while the AI itself is simply shown the door.
